proposal.summary: Adobe After Effects 22.0 (and earlier) and 18.4.2 (and earlier) have an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that can disclose sensitive memory and may bypass mitigations such as ASLR; exploitation requires a victim to open a malicious file.
proposal.cwe_quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

AV.quote: Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

UI.quote: Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

C.quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or obtain a proof-of-concept and reproduction steps from the reporter, and confirm whether any privilege or sandbox escape is required; then verify the vulnerability and produce a CVE and patch timeline.

out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.
